title: Content Pack Manifest
description: The pack.json file at the root of a content pack, decoded by ContentPackManifest(jsonData:). Base content, expansions, and mods all use this format.

packID.description: A pack identifier. It prefixes the pack's item IDs, so it cannot contain ':' or whitespace.

version.description: The pack's own version, for display only.

format.description: The content format the pack is written in. The engine rejects formats it cannot read.

dependencies.description: Packs that must load first. A pack cannot depend on itself.

overrides.description: Qualified item IDs, such as "base:fridge", that this pack replaces. Each must belong to a direct or indirect dependency and be defined in this pack's items.json.
